questions.subject: Physiology
questions.sourceReviewMethod: Poppler rendered-page visual review; native JPEG pixel review; pypdf XObject raw-stream hash and content-matrix inspection; registry bindings inspected
questions.evidence: Poppler rendered PDF pages654-656 visually inspected; original native stream and existing registry region pixels compared. Page655 content uses /Im1 xref1672, DCTDecode, no mask; native image excludes choice text present at bottom of existing region. The labelled PAH graph belongs to the question continuation before its four matching choices; labels A-D are essential to selecting B.
